New plan: 

In my previous attempt, I tried to calculate the date a month ago by subtracting 31 days from the current date, but this led to an infinite loop of incorrect dates. What I should have done is to simply subtract 30 days from the current date, since May has 31 days. If the result is still in May, I should subtract 1 more day to get the last day of May. Then, I can simply subtract 1 month from the last day of May to get the date a month ago. 

For example, if the current date is May 30, 2021, I should subtract 30 days to get April 31, 2021. Since April 31, 2021 is not a valid date, I should subtract 1 more day to get April 30, 2021. Then, I can simply subtract 1 month from April 30, 2021 to get March 31, 2021.
